summary: Adds a 'Search engine visibility' switch for whole help-center portals (new SEO settings tab) and per article; hidden pages get an X-Robots-Tag: noindex header and are dropped from the public sitemap.xml, but stay reachable by link.

statements.why: No security, data-loss or money problem: new settings go through existing authorized portal/article update endpoints; public pages only gain a header and a filtered sitemap.

misses.what: The actual feature: admins can now hide the whole help center or single articles from Google/search engines (new SEO tab in portal settings, switch in article properties); portal setting overrides articles.

Hidden portals/articles are sent with an X-Robots-Tag: noindex header and removed from the public sitemap, so turning the switch off will drop pages from search results (they remain reachable by direct link, i.e. not private).
